initialExam.title: RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) 2026
initialExam.description: Assistant Loco Pilot and Technician recruitment for Indian Railways. Application closed June 14; CBT-1 expected August 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: 10th pass + ITI/Diploma in relevant engineering trade
initialExam.syllabus: CBT-1: Mathematics (20Q), General Intelligence/Reasoning (25Q), General Science (20Q). CBT-2: Part A (same as CBT-1) + Part B (Trade-specific technical questions).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT-1: 65 questions, 65 marks, 60 min. CBT-2: Part A + Part B, 100+75 marks. CBAT for ALP only.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT-1 → CBT-2 → CBAT (for ALP) → Document Verification → Medical
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant Loco Pilot and Technician in Indian Railways
initialExam.careerGrowth: ALP → Loco Pilot → Senior Loco Pilot → Power Controller.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rrbcdg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload ITI/Diploma certificates 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Running Allowance, Free Rail passes, Medical, Pension
